historical_reviews.deepseek: Correctly rejects agent-only execution and preserves both physical color/behavior requirements.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Refines NO to MANUAL ONLY and adds explicit port identity, safe bounded traffic and separate evidence for Link and Activity states.
historical_reviews.related_cases: MST/ibstat and link-flap rows provide electronic state but cannot replace direct LED color and blink observation.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Physical visual acceptance remains manual; optional automation cannot upgrade it to a fully automated verdict.

original_test_intent: Confirm the specified Mellanox Ethernet port displays a solid green Link indication when linked and a blinking green Activity indication during real bounded traffic.
original_method: A qualified operator identifies the mapped physical port and captures its idle/link and bounded-traffic LED behavior against the approved vendor legend; an agent may only corroborate link and counter changes.
manual_activity: Qualified operator directly observes and photographs solid-green Link and blinking-green Activity on the exact physical Mellanox port under approved conditions.
required_inputs: Vendor-approved Link and Activity LED legend for the installed hardware
Stable link condition and safe bounded traffic source/destination/rate
Qualified operator with safe physical access and photo/video capture
Optional secure OS link/counter access and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify the exact port and vendor LED legend before observation
Use only approved bounded traffic and avoid management/BMC/production impact
Do not unplug, toggle or reconfigure links merely to force an LED state
Stop on wrong port, unsafe access, ambiguous color/blink, connector damage or unexpected traffic impact
Preserve photos/video with timing and conditions; electronic counters are not visual proof
agent_execution_scope: Optionally collect read-only port identity, link, speed and counter evidence
Correlate bounded traffic interval with operator timestamps
Do not claim to see LEDs, manipulate hardware, generate unapproved traffic or issue the verdict
engineer_actions: Ensure qualified operator records both required visual states
Review physical evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies that no agent command can establish the physical visual result.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No command substitutes for observation; optional read-only link/counter monitoring may corroborate the operator's bounded-traffic interval.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Physical LED check, blinking-green Activity, solid-green Link and 10/10 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture separate, labeled physical evidence for stable Link and bounded Activity states with exact port and timing correlation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines test conditions and evidence so two visually distinct criteria cannot collapse into one observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No manual coverage is replaced by software inference.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Lighting, camera frame rate and vendor color conventions can make blink/color ambiguous; repeat only under operator control and approved conditions.

project_override_considerations: Project hardware revision and transceiver may alter LED coding, so the approved legend for the exact assembly governs acceptance.
expected_evidence: Photo/video of solid-green Link under established link
Photo/video of blinking-green Activity during the recorded bounded traffic window
Traffic definition and optional link/speed/counter corroboration

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master, DeepSeek and GPT V2 agree that physical LED observation is required and cannot be replaced by remote software output.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The case is manual rather than inherently blocked when the SUT, qualified operator, approved legend and safe traffic are available.

review_improvement: Separates Link and Activity conditions and makes the visual evidence auditable without falsely attributing eyesight to an agent.
independent_technical_reasoning: A carrier-up bit or increasing counter can corroborate link and traffic but cannot establish emitted color, steady versus blinking behavior or that the observed LED belongs to the mapped port. Those acceptance facts require direct, time-correlated physical observation under defined traffic conditions.
